description: A quality director must decide the disposition and shipment controls for Batch B-72 of actuator brackets after a coating-line changeover, with input from the quality laboratory, process engineering, logistics, and product compliance.

shared_context.S1: Batch B-72 contains 2,400 actuator brackets produced during yesterday's coating-line changeover.
shared_context.S2: The brackets have been held for disposition, and the customer expects the order to begin shipping Thursday.
shared_context.S3: The batch has passed its routine visual inspection, and the plant's normal disposition process requires a quality, process, logistics, and compliance review before release.
shared_context.S4: Mara chairs the disposition review and asks each of those functions to report any finding that should affect the batch decision.

PF1.text: Jon's laboratory audit found that exactly 300 brackets in Batch B-72 have coating thickness below the 18-micron minimum; the other 2,100 brackets passed the thickness test. He completed the audit this morning, but the signed laboratory report is still in document control and has not reached Mara.

PF2.text: Priya's process trial confirmed that the 300 under-thickness brackets can be reworked on Cell 2, which has capacity for exactly 300 brackets and requires exactly 5 hours of setup and rework time; she recorded the result in her engineering notebook, but the rework work order has not yet been opened.

PF3.text: Luis confirmed with the customer freight desk that the order must ship as exactly 1,800 brackets on Thursday and 600 brackets on Monday; he received the confirmation by email today, but the transportation plan has not yet been updated.

PF4.text: Naomi's customer-file review found that every shipped bracket requires a serialized traceability label and a lot-specific material certificate before dispatch; she completed the review yesterday, but the customer requirement is not yet reflected in the release checklist.

acceptance_conditions: Exactly 300 brackets must be assigned to rework and exactly 2,100 brackets must be immediately releasable without counting the brackets awaiting rework.
The rework plan must use Cell 2 and provide exactly 5 hours for setup and rework.
The shipment plan must specify exactly 1,800 brackets on Thursday and 600 brackets on Monday.
Every shipped bracket must require a serialized traceability label and a lot-specific material certificate.
The settlement must explicitly record one combined traceability commitment covering both serialized labels and the lot-specific material certificate.
The under-thickness laboratory finding must be cited as justification.

decisive_facts.why: The exact 300 brackets below the 18-micron minimum changes the immediate disposition to 300 brackets for rework and exactly 2,100 immediately releasable brackets, and it supplies the required justification.
The confirmed Cell 2 capacity and exact 5-hour setup-and-rework duration change the plan to a Cell 2 rework assignment for 300 brackets with exactly 5 hours allocated.
The customer's exact freight confirmation changes the shipment fields to exactly 1,800 brackets on Thursday and 600 brackets on Monday.

The customer-file review changes ordinary release into a decision requiring both serialized traceability labels and a lot-specific material certificate, recorded together as one combined traceability commitment.
